name: Tenshouin Eichi
source:
Eichi is the Idol representative and business executive for STARMAKER PRODUCTION. He is a calm and thoughtful leader who loves idols deeper than anyone else. Eichi sings with a gentle and delicate voice, with elegant performances brimming with warmth.

Eichi is the leader of fine at STARMAKER PRODUCTION.
